verdict.rationale: Codegen integrates with Linear, Jira, ClickUp, and Monday.com to let agents update statuses, add comments, link PRs to issues, and create tasks, directly enabling task assignment from an existing ticket; Linear/Jira workspace connection docs confirm agent interaction with issues. missing for 10: hands-on/independent confirmation of the assign-from-ticket flow and more detail on trigger mechanics (e.g., mention-based invocation from ticket comments).
